2115833525404647542.en_summary: Michael Sikand posts a chart explainer titled $MRVL x $LITE mega merger explained, without stating a directional view in the text.
2115833525404647542.zh_summary: Michael Sikand 發布題為 $MRVL 與 $LITE 巨型合併解說的圖表說明，正文未表明多空方向。

2115833682091204949.en_summary: EliteOptions2 says dips were bought: if $AMD reclaims 581 then 600 comes fast; $SMH showing relative strength, through 570 could see 590-600; $SPX held 7700 and $QQQ held 715, expecting the bottom in by next week and a melt-up rally soon.
2115833682091204949.zh_summary: EliteOptions2 表示回檔被買入：$AMD 若收復 581 則 600 很快；$SMH 相對強勢，突破 570 可見 590 至 600；$SPX 守住 7700、$QQQ 守住 715，預期下周前見底並很快出現熔漲行情。

2115842367924449731.en_summary: Charlie Bilello reports Google Q3 revenue up 25% YoY to a record $128B, operating income up 30% to $41B, net income down 25% to $26B on $8B unrealized equity losses (SpaceX Q3 decline), and Cloud revenue up 103% YoY to a record $31B; $GOOGL (with chart).
2115842367924449731.zh_summary: Charlie Bilello 報告谷歌第三季營收同比增 25% 至創紀錄 1280 億美元，營業利益增 30% 至 410 億，淨利因 80 億未實現股權虧損（SpaceX 第三季下跌）同比降 25% 至 260 億，雲業務營收同比增 103% 至創紀錄 310 億；$GOOGL（附圖）。

2115843152326348870.en_summary: Charlie Bilello notes Google reported negative free cash flow of $9B in Q3 on massive AI infrastructure capex (property and equipment spending up 114% YoY to $51B), calling it Google's largest FCF decline ever and only the second quarterly decline in company history; $GOOGL (with charts).
2115843152326348870.zh_summary: Charlie Bilello 指出谷歌第三季自由現金流為負 90 億美元，主因 AI 基建資本開支龐大（不動產與設備支出同比增 114% 至 510 億），為公司史上最大自由現金流降幅，亦僅第二次季度下降；$GOOGL（附圖）。

2115846890033987942.en_summary: Jason asks what escrow service is good for managing bets like Grant Cardone's $1M wager that Bitcoin hits or exceeds $126,210.50 by Oct. 28, 2028, tagging $BTC without stating his own directional view.
2115846890033987942.zh_summary: Jason 詢問適合管理此類打賭的託管服務，背景是 Grant Cardone 以 100 萬美元打賭比特幣在 2028 年 10 月 28 日前觸及或超過 126210.50 美元，僅標記 $BTC 未表明自身方向。
